content: Isra7eele Bolla Dawite Kawoteth
Isra7eele asay ubbay Kebroone Dawitekko biidi, «Hekko nuni ne meqeththatanne ne ashota.
Kase Sa7ooli nu bolla kawoti diza wode Isra7eele ola asaa kaaleththizay nena; GODAY, ‹Ta dere Isra7eele naaganay nena; istta kaaleththanay nena gidana› giidi nees yooti woththides» gida.
Hessa gishshas Isra7eele asaa kaaleththizayti ubbay Kebroone yida; kawo Dawiti Kebroonen GODAA sinththan isttara caaqo qaala gelides; isttika Dawite tiydi Isra7eele bolla kawoththida.
Dawiti kawotishin izas layththay 30; izi 40 layth deraa ayssides.
Izi Kebroonen uttidi Yuhuda bolla laappun layththinne usuppun agina, Yerusalaamen uttidi kumeththa Isra7eele bollanne Yuhuda bolla 33 layth kawotides.
Yerusalaame Xooneteth

Kawozinne iza asay Yerusalaamen diza Yaabuse asaa olanaas hee bida. Yaabuse asaykka Dawite, «Dawiti hayssan gelana dandayenna» gi qoppida gishshas Dawites, «Haray attoshin qooqetinne wobbeti nena teqqana; hessa gishshas ne haa gelakka» gida.
Gido attiin Dawiti Xiyoone miixa oykkides; hinnaka ha7i Dawite katama geetettizasohoyo.

He gallas Dawiti, «Yaabuse asaa xoonana koyzay, Dawite morkke gidida wobbetakkonne qooqetakko gakkanaas haath pinniza purdera pudunththaa kezanaas bessees» gides; hessa gishshas, «Wobbetinne qooqeti kawo keeth gelettenna» geetettides.
Hessafe guye Dawiti miixayo baas duussaso histtides; izo, «Dawite katama» gi sunththides. Dawiti Miiloppe doommidi izo giddo aaththidi yuuyi aadhdhanaas gimbides.
GODAY Ubbaafe Wolqqama Xoossay izara diza gishshas Dawiti ubba wode minni minni bides.
He wode Xiroose kawo Kiraamey Dawitekko as kiita yeddides; hessaththoka ziga mith massiza hiillanchchatanne shuch massiza hiillanchchata yeddides; isttika Dawites kawo keeth keexxida.
GODAY Isra7eele bolla iza kawoteththaa minththidayssa, ba deraa Isra7eele gishshas iza kawoteththaa aassidayssa Dawiti erides.
Dawiti Kebrooneppe bidaappe guye kaseyta bolla Yerusalaamen hara laggeththota woththides; machchetakka ekkides; hara attuma naytinne macca nayti izas yelettida.
Izi Yerusalaamen yelida nayti, Shaamu7e, Shoobaabe, Naataane, Solomoone,
Iyabeheere, Elshu7e, Nefege, Naafiya,
Elshama, El7aadanne Elfaleexe geetetteettes.
Filisxeeme Xooneteth
Dawiti Isra7eele asaa bolla kawotidayssa Filisxeeme asay siyidi iza koyanaas gixxi dendides; hessa siyidi Dawiti duge ba miixa wodhdhides.
He wode Filisxeeme asay yiidi Erafayme shoobban laaletti dunkaanides.
Hessa gishshas Dawiti GODAA, «Baada Filisxeeme asaara olettoo? Ne istta ta kushen aaththa immanee?» gi oychchides. GODAYKKA iza, «Ee ba; tumappe Filisxeemeta tani ne kushen aaththa immana» gides.
Hessa gishshas Dawiti Ba7aali-Paraaxime

biidi Filisxeeme asaa oli xoonides; izikka, «Di7o haaththi dhuuqqi kezidi laalliza mala, GODAY ta morkketa ta sinththafe laallides» gides. Hessa gaason he sohoza sunththi Ba7aali-Paraaxime geetettides.
Filisxeeme asay ba eeqa xoossata yeggi aggidi baqatida gishshas Dawitinne iza kaalliza asay di7i ekki bida.
Filisxeeme asay qasseka yiidi Erafayme shoobban laaletti dunkaanides.
Hessa gishshas Dawiti GODAA oychchides; GODAYKKA izas, «Isttafe guye baggara istta giddoththada balasaane miththaafe sinththa baggara baada isttara gaytta attiin istti dizaso sitti ga kezoppa.
Balasaane miththa xeera bollara ola giiris siyiza wode GODAY Filisxeeme ola asaa olanaas neeppe kaseti kezides guus gidida gishshas he wode eesotada sinth sitti ga ba» gides.
Hessa gishshas Dawiti GODAY iza azazida mala ooththides; Filisxeeme asaakka Geebappe biidi Gezeere gakkanaas gooddi gooddi shocides.

footnotes.text: Ibraaweta qaalara Ba7aali-Paraaxime guussi Menththereththidi gelida godaa guussa.
